legalName: Savo, Schalk, Corsini, Warner, Gillespie, O'Grodnick & Fisher, P.A.
summary: A full-service law firm in historic Somerville, overlooking the Somerset County Courthouse, representing businesses, government bodies and individuals throughout New Jersey, New York and Maine.

address.note: 3rd floor of the Hamon Building. Reserved spaces on the east side of the building, or use the parking deck in the rear.

serviceArea: All of New Jersey, plus New York and Maine
about: We regard the representation of our clients as an honor, a privilege and a steadfast responsibility. Our goal is to provide the best legal services in a convenient, caring and cost-effective manner.

We are one of the largest and most successful law firms in Somerset County, with a distinguished history and a team of diverse, capable attorneys who have earned the respect of judges, prosecutors and fellow lawyers for their integrity and technical knowledge.
Our offices are in historic Somerville, overlooking the Somerset County Courthouse.
